verifiedRecords.exactComputation: The §4.3 proof gives O(λ²L²T) total work for T updates, with λ=O(log^{1+o(1)}Δ) and L=O(logΔ/loglogΔ). The figure uses the safe O(polylog Δ) consequence.
verifiedRecords.notes: The o(1) tends to zero as Δ grows. This palette family is not an ε tradeoff and does not promise Δ+1 colors. Constant-degree cases use ordinary O(Δ) updates. Determinism permits updates based on past outputs.

coverage: Eight maintenance records from seven primary papers, plus a separately scoped decision lower bound. GH2026 is an arXiv v2 claim accepted for SODA 2027; its theorem statement and model were checked.
